items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Joe' in the context of an incident at a club (Ratso's/Samski's), but the interviewer clarifies this 'Joe' is Joe Hamilton, not Joe Henderson. The interviewee only acknowledges Joe Henderson indirectly via the interviewer's statement that a woman played with him, responding

ctx.x: Was that Ratso’s? Or where was that? One of those places up north.
Ratso’s. Joe got so angry at me.
Glen. Glen got angry at you.
